mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 9, low 6.

Keratoconus disease affecting vision, especially adolescents; ophthalmologist Rrona Gjini-Bytyqi explained symptoms and treatment in a podcast.

Opposition party Aleanta says the loss of €43.8 million from EU Growth Plan funds proves government incompetence and irresponsibility.

After the municipal elections in Bërvenicë, VLEN deputy Izet Mexhiti urged political leaders to lower tensions and resume dialogue in the multi-ethnic community.

Zenun Krasniqi, head of the Albanian-German Business Union, said diaspora investors are shifting from family-linked ventures to more diversified business projects in Kosovo.

A masked robber in black clothing stole cash from a second-tier bank in the Paris municipality district of Tirana around 10:45 a.m., and police are investigating.
